predictions.quote: you start out with the million people who are what we call criminal migrants people who have committed violent crimes in some form or another get them out of our country
predictions.prediction: A Trump-Vance administration's deportation effort will begin by removing roughly one million "criminal migrants" (those who committed violent crimes) from the country.

predictions.quote: you've got to stop the millions of people flowing across the southern border every single year it happened because of KLA Harris's policies it's going to stop when Donald Trump is President

predictions.quote: I don't know how easy it is to get another 300 bips of growth but I think you can get a lot more growth whether it's 300 or 150 just by massively reducing the amount of regulatory burden in the real economy
